name: spectrum-7b-highk
description: High-budget pass@k (32/64/128) re-run for SPECTRUM on Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct, 1 round, MBPP 500 tasks x 128 samples, seed 43. One config shares a single base@128 eval across four arms: plain (SFT baseline), spectral_soft(tau=1), spd_hard(rank=256), residual_blend(rho=0.5). ks=[1,4,8,16,32,64,128]. Purpose: check whether the diversity gain (flat +1pt at pass@16) widens at higher k. Train checkpoints from the earlier operator sweep were pruned to free disk, so these arms are re-trained.
